tasks.short: Counsel individuals about personal and religious problems

steps.what: Counsel individuals through listening, clarification, guidance and appropriate referral

tasks.design: Keep counselling with the director and refer specialist needs within the director's competence. Existing referral information in {DOCS} supports the conversation; no new preparation or recording step is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personal guidance depends on trust and individual circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported automation changes the counselling relationship.
tasks.still_hard: Distress and problems beyond pastoral competence.
tasks.human_edge: The director listens, recognises limits and supports appropriate referral.
tasks.altitude: No change in counselling time or authority.

evidence.claim: Personal counselling remains human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is the live counselling interaction, excluding treatment by specialists and separate administration.
The individual supplies concerns during the conversation and the director clarifies them within s1's100 hours; no structured diagnosis or counselling profile is assumed.
No new system or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Referral resources and local competence boundaries
research_questions: Are referral routes clear when an individual's needs exceed the director's competence?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, zero upkeep; listening and guidance remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on religious education goals and participation

steps.what: Discuss community needs and participation barriers with ministry members
Agree religious education goals and ways to encourage program participation

tasks.design: Retain collaborative discussion and goal setting. Existing plans in {DOCS} inform the meeting, but member administration capabilities do not substitute for shared educational judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation barriers and programme purpose require community understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No change to the collaboration itself is supported by the digest.
tasks.human_edge: The director builds agreement without reducing people to participation scores.
tasks.altitude: No change to collaborative time or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Agreeing programme goals and participation approaches remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary is director participation in goal-setting discussion; others' meeting time and separate member-data analysis are excluded.
Director elicits concerns during s1's45 hours; no structured participation-barrier code or new member data capture is assumed.
Existing plans remain unchanged; no new tool or upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: What barriers do ministry members identify that existing participation totals miss?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, zero upkeep; community discussion and shared decisions retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train and supervise religious education staff

steps.what: Train instructional staff through demonstration, discussion and practice
Observe instructional work, give feedback and address staff concerns

tasks.design: Keep practical training, observation and supervisory feedback human. Existing programme guidance in {DOCS} supports the work; no unobserved course-writing baseline or automatic staff rating is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff development depends on observed practice and contextual feedback.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported tool removes the director's instructional or supervisory contact.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting feedback to individual confidence and competence.
tasks.human_edge: The director models good instruction and handles concerns respectfully.
tasks.altitude: No change in training or supervision time.

evidence.claim: Training and supervisory relationships remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is director training and supervision, excluding instructional staff's own teaching time and separate curriculum development.
Director identifies learning needs during s1 and observes performance in s2; all capture and interpretation are included in their full shares.
No new records or tools are added; zero incremental upkeep is justified.
unknowns: Staff learning needs and supervision arrangements
research_questions: Which practical skills need more observation and coaching?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; direct staff development time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Implement program logistics and administrative arrangements

steps.what: Confirm required materials, speakers, rooms, dates and spending limits
Prepare, check and submit orders for needed materials
Arrange speaker times and reserve suitable space
Resolve delivery and booking exceptions and confirm programme readiness

tasks.design: Configure reusable orders in {PROCUREMENT} and shared room and speaker arrangements in {CALENDAR}. The director confirms requirements, checks each commitment before sending and resolves exceptions personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme details are repeatedly copied into orders and booking messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order templates and booking views can reuse checked logistics details.
tasks.still_hard: Speaker changes, unsuitable rooms and late deliveries need negotiation.
tasks.human_edge: The director balances programme needs and real resource constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less logistics entry; spending and booking commitments remain human decisions.

evidence.claim: Configured ordering and calendar booking can reduce repeated event-logistics entry; the savings are a model scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers director logistics implementation; suppliers' fulfilment and speakers' preparation remain outside its denominator.

Director produces item, quantity, supplier choice, spending limit, speaker, date range, room capacity and access needs in s1's25 hours. Speakers and venue staff supply availability through unchanged booking interactions. Missing information requires manual clarification in retained s2-s4 time; no free structured availability feed is assumed.
Test native order and calendar features before custom automation. No member register or sensitive counselling information is needed.
research_questions: Does detail reuse reduce total logistics work after checking commitments and handling changes?

already_counted.description: Order checks, booking checks and exception resolution

incremental.description: Maintain reusable orders and booking templates

approvals.approved_version: Final supplier order with item, quantity, cost, delivery date and destination; changes void approval
Final speaker and room booking snapshot with dates, conditions and recipients; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R72, gross28 minus4 upkeep net24. Low assumes only8 hours repeated entry removed due to many negotiated arrangements; requirements25 and final exception work20 remain full.
